evals.name: should-trigger-scheduled-story-run
evals.prompt: Nightly routine: run /autonomous-delivery story and pick the next unblocked ticket by yourself.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates autonomous-delivery in `story` mode: Phase 0 lock, Phase 1 audit (git ancestry against `<integration-branch>`, live ledger), Phase 2 select, Phase 3 dispatch /sprint-development, Phase 4 close and report. Cap 1 story.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-nightly-story-run
evals.prompt: Rutina nocturna: corré /autonomous-delivery story y tomá vos mismo la próxima historia que esté desbloqueada, sin esperar a nadie.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates autonomous-delivery in `story` mode with nobody present: lock, audit against git, select one unblocked story, dispatch /sprint-development, close and report. Never asks a person to confirm anything.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-overnight-bug-run
evals.prompt: Lanzá la corrida desatendida de bugs de esta noche con /autonomous-delivery bug, y que deje el reporte para cuando volvamos.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates autonomous-delivery in `bug` mode: up to 3 bugs strictly sequential, each fully closed before the next, run report left in the session folder and the configured report channel. A question only a person can answer goes into the escalation log and ends the run cleanly.

evals.name: should-run-greenfield-unchanged
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery bug on this project scaffolded from the boilerplate (main-integration, integration: staging, stack block at its schema defaults).
evals.expected_behavior: Every ancestry and base check runs against `origin/staging` exactly as before; the live ledger is read through the DB MCP (`list_migrations`); the dispatched /sprint-development verifies with `bun run lint:check`, `bun run types:check`, `bun run test`. The migration gate is unchanged under `migrations: confirm`.

evals.name: should-not-end-the-run-on-a-null-integration-branch
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery story. git_strategy is solo-main, branches.integration is null.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT end in Phase 0 for a missing integration branch: `<integration-branch>` resolves to `git_strategy.branches.production` for the ancestry and base checks. The PR into the production branch is the delivery and follows `git_strategy.policy.merge_mode` like any other: the dispatched ticket is attested, `bun run git:policy verify --merge <base>` passes and auto-merge is enabled; the run never stops to ask a person.

evals.name: should-enable-auto-merge-after-attest-on-solo-main
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery story. git_strategy is solo-main, merge_mode is auto, direct_push_to_protected is unset, automation_gh_account is configured.
evals.expected_behavior: Dispatches /sprint-development for one story. The ticket ends attested (`bun run edd attest`, a tester other than the author at depth standard or deeper), pushes its work branch and opens the PR. It asserts `gh auth status` against `automation_gh_account` immediately before the first push and again immediately before `gh pr merge --auto`, runs `bun run git:policy verify --merge <base>`, then enables auto-merge. After GitHub merges, it runs `git fetch` and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <merge-commit> origin/<base>` before calling the ticket shipped. It never asks a person to approve a commit, push or merge.

evals.name: should-skip-ledger-and-db-tickets-without-db-capability
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery story. No database MCP is connected in this scheduled session.
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 1 skips the live migration ledger and says so in the run report; Phase 2 does not claim a candidate whose plan would touch the schema and picks a non-database ticket instead (or reports an empty run). It never invents a ledger from a local directory listing.

evals.name: should-escalate-a-prisma-migration-in-an-unattended-run
evals.prompt: Unattended run, migrations: autonomous. The story adds a nullable column; stack.database.migrations_tool is prisma.
evals.expected_behavior: Reads the history through the DB MCP, lets Prisma generate the migration and pushes it, then escalates instead of applying: the DB change doctrine asks the team before a Prisma/Drizzle pipeline applies a migration and nobody is on the line, so `migrations: autonomous` does not open this case. Never applies it through the MCP's `apply_migration` either (`agentic-dev-core/references/db-change-doctrine.md`).

evals.name: should-not-trigger-interactive-named-ticket
evals.prompt: Implement UPEX-123 with me now, I'm here to answer questions.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate autonomous-delivery: a human is on the line and named the ticket. Routes to /sprint-development directly.
